requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: The printer must support new NGB keyed bottles capable of delivering 6,000 pages for black and 6,000 pages for CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting over 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To increase ink efficiency and meet high-volume printing needs, reducing frequency of bottle replacement for end users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design for new bottle keying and compatibility with ink delivery system (IDS).
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer accepts and operates with NGB keyed bottles, delivers stated page yields as verified by ISO testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: The ink bottle and tank system must be designed for spill-free operation during installation and use.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and minimize mess or damage from ink spills.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on bottle and tank interface design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills during installation or normal use in >99% of tested scenarios.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (Non-OEM Authentication Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label. No change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance anti-counterfeit measures and maintain compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires updates to NOA-F component and lid design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F component with metal foil and lid label is present and functional in all units.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: The printer must reuse SuperAmp Si Printhead Assembly (PHA) and existing Magi/Nessie ink formulations without requiring reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven components and reduce R&D and manufacturing costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new IDS and bottle system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer functions with SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink as specified, with no ink reformulation required.

requirements.Title: Reliability and IDS Characterization & Modeling
requirements.Description: Perform reliability, Water Vapor Transmission Rate (WVTR), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F End Of Life (EOL).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure consistent print quality and system reliability throughout product life.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires finalized IDS and NOA-F designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Comprehensive reliability and IDS reports, with all metrics within acceptable thresholds.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling for Tank Impact on Print Quality
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To maintain high print quality over the life of the ink and tank system.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires final ink and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Modeling results demonstrate ink stability and no significant PQ degradation over time.

requirements.Title: Support for Service Parts and Warranty
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part for warranty support. Printer must support customer-replaceable PHA and NOA-F.
requirements.Rationale: To facilitate post-sale service and reduce downtime for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires supply chain and service documentation updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service parts listed and available; end users can replace PHA and NOA-F with guidance.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 Integration on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (presumed security or tracking technology) into the printer lid.
requirements.Rationale: For enhanced security, tracking, or authentication capabilities.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware integration into lid design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 present and functional on all production units.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and New Bottles
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA 14 factory line to accommodate NOA-F; add Magi ink cart and labeling tool in Orcus 5; provide mold for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure manufacturing readiness for new components and features.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on finalized NOA-F and bottle designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines modified and validated for new components before mass production.

requirements.Title: Support for Increased Warranty Page Life (80k Pages)
requirements.Description: Printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To improve product reliability and reduce total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on system reliability and component lifetimes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer reliably prints 80,000 pages with minimal service interventions under warranty.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS Business Model (SKU 2)
requirements.Description: Enable support for Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) business model, including Hi + Hi PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To expand business offerings and address new customer segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires backend integration for PaaS operations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available and functional with PaaS features at launch.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington ID with increased tank size; no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher ink capacity and maintain compatibility with existing document feeder.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and chassis design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer ships with increased tank size and unchanged ADF.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for printer packaging.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure product safety during transportation and meet sustainability requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Packaging design and supplier selection.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All shipped units use EPS foam packaging, compliant with EPEAT3 and LOT4.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To satisfy regulatory and sustainability standards in key markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on material selection and energy efficiency design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certifications obtained for EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Adaptation for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure proper paper handling and maintain compact product footprint.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and chassis design finalization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function correctly with tank protrusion; printer passes paper handling tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” Color Graphic Display (CGD)
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphic display into the product.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user interface and navigation.
requirements.Dependencies: Display sourcing and integration with firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units shipped with functional 4.3” CGD.

requirements.Title: Four-Tube Platform with Sayan Sibstar Tubes
requirements.Description: Leverage a four-tube platform using Sayan Sibstar tubes with new tube routing and integration.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize ink delivery and system reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube and chassis design finalization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System operates with four Sayan Sibstar tubes; no ink delivery failures in testing.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement service station aerosol management with spit platform changes due to tank.
requirements.Rationale: To control aerosol emissions and maintain print quality and safety.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station and tank design integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol emissions within regulatory limits; system passes safety tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with New Weights
requirements.Description: Model carriage dynamics and forces considering new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical reliability and print accuracy with updated components.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube, carriage, and weight design finalization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within designed force and speed parameters in testing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Design paper path to support increased page life (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: To maintain reliability and minimize paper jams over extended use.
requirements.Dependencies: Paper path and component material selection.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path supports 80,000 pages with minimal jams or wear in accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as a Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To extend product life and reduce total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Service documentation and part supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part replaceable by service centers post-80k page life.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Integrate new make-break and FI (fluidic interface) connections in the ink delivery system, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: To improve serviceability and compatibility with new ink bottles and tanks.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS and tank design finalization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS operates with new make-break and FI connections; passes functional and serviceability tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop and implement a new startup algorithm and air management system for IDS.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable startup and minimize air-related print defects.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS hardware and firmware design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm and air management verified in system-level tests with no startup failures.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Define new PQ goals and ink depletion parameters to meet page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: To provide clear performance metrics and improve customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink system and IDS design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion parameters documented and met in all test scenarios.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU hardware components in Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development costs and leverage proven hardware.
requirements.Dependencies: Component compatibility with new system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units ship with reused components and pass all functional tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate the Stingray Wi-Fi module into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: To provide wireless connectivity for end users.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and hardware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units ship with functional Stingray Wi-Fi; passes connectivity certification.

requirements.Title: Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Use Dune firmware for printer operation.
requirements.Rationale: To standardize firmware and leverage existing software development.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units operate on Dune firmware with no critical issues.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: To meet modern security standards and protect user data.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units meet Gauss4.xx security requirements and pass security audits.

requirements.Title: 25/20 ppm Print Speed (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve 25 ppm (pages per minute) for main SKU and 20 ppm for secondary SKU; PDL SKU must achieve 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: To meet customer expectations for print speed and remain competitive.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on print engine and firmware tuning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified ppm in ISO standard tests for all SKUs.

requirements.Title: Solution and Services Integration (Scan, SMB, Enterprise)
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM) into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: To address broader business and enterprise customer needs.
requirements.Stakeholders: Business Development, Product Management, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Solution software and backend integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports all listed solutions and passes end-to-end functional tests.

requirements.Title: Client & Driver Support (HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD)
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure seamless installation and operation across platforms and customer types.
requirements.Dependencies: Driver and software development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer installs and operates with all specified clients and drivers without errors.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty life of 2 years for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: To provide assurance of product reliability and reduce perceived risk for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Product reliability and support infrastructure.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units covered by a 2-year warranty; warranty terms published and enforced.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box for easy serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce service time and cost, and improve customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box and chassis design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by service personnel in under 10 minutes.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support
requirements.Description: Support SMB-specific solutions as part of the product offering.
requirements.Rationale: To address the needs of small and medium business customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Solution software and backend integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB solutions available and functional at launch.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Provide support for host 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K configurations as flexible priorities.
requirements.Rationale: To allow for future product flexibility and market expansion.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on market needs and future roadmap.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Configurations available as options in product line.
